results.text: Association between Complete Proteinuria Remission and Kidney Function in the Phase 3 PROTECT Trial of Sparsentan in IgA Nephropathy. In the phase 3, randomized, double-blind PROTECT (NCT03762850) trial, sparsentan, a single-molecule dual endothelin angiotensin receptor antagonist (DEARA), reduced proteinuria and preserved kidney function compared to maximum labeled dose irbesartan in adults with immunoglobulin A nephropathy.
